sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:8

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:8:1
items.html: Nekudot, which are females and reflected light, MAN [Mayin Nukvin]: Malchut is called a point, and this is after the root Malchut upon which the first restriction took place, which is called the middle point. Therefore the Malchuts and the females in all the worlds are called Nekudot [dots], since they are the bearers of the restriction and of the screen, upon which the coupling by striking with the upper light is made. And this is what he says: that through the death of these kings, all of whom are mighty judgments, etc., they are Nekudot, which are females and reflected light and MAN. For these three are one matter, namely the screen that raises reflected light and unites and couples the upper Partzufim at the time when the sortings of BYA rise to them as MAN. And the explanation of this matter will come further on, God willing.
